The '''T0-D interrogation droid''' was a wheeled model used by [[Imperial Intelligence/Legends|Imperial Intelligence]]<ref name="Sword" /> and the [[Imperial Security Bureau/Legends|Imperial Security Bureau]],<ref name="Threats" /> including aboard the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star I]].<ref name="SSW">''[[Super Star Wars]]''</ref> It was equipped with two claws, a [[Stun baton/Legends|stun baton]], a [[Sonic stunner/Legends|sonic stunner]], a basic [[Processor/Legends|processor]], two tool mounts, an improved [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] package, twenty kilograms of internal storage, a [[Durasteel/Legends|durasteel]] shell, and a [[Vocabulator/Legends|vocabulator]].<ref name="Threats" />

==Behind the scenes==
After being introduced in some ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' sourcebooks,<ref name="IS">''[[Imperial Sourcebook]]''</ref> these [[droid]]s -- unnamed -- appeared as enemies in the [[Wikipedia:Super Nintendo Entertainment System|Super Nintendo]] game ''[[Super Star Wars]]''.<ref name="SSW" /> First encountered in "Level 10: Death Star Bay", these droids used their claws to deal damage. The ''[[Super Star Wars Official Game Secrets]]'' guide to the game refers to them as '''Buggy Droids'''.<ref name="Secrets">''[[Super Star Wars Official Game Secrets]]''</ref>
